dependencies.name: pdfcpu
dependencies.note: Compiled directly into this binary — the actual PDF engine behind every operation here (merge, split, rotate, compress, encrypt). Not a separate install; listed for transparency about what this app is built on.

requirements.name: Chrome or Chromium-based browser
requirements.note: Any Chromium-based browser works: Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Microsoft Edge, or Arc. Used to render the app's own UI window, same as video-clipper and instaframe.
